rules.statement: The court may draw a presumption of ouster when a party's long and continuous possession of land is not disturbed for a period of 10 years, and the party has not claimed any improvements or plantations on the land.
rules.supporting_quote: The presumption of ouster is drawn in certain circumstances when exclusive possession has been so long continued that it is not reasonable to call upon the party who relies on it to adduce evidence that at a specific point of time in the distant past there was in fact a denial of the rights of the other co-owners.
